ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given: As shown in the figure, $OA$ and $OB$ are two radii of $\odot O$, and $OA \perp OB$. Point $C$ is on $\odot O$. What is the measure of $\angle ACB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OA \perp OB$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$,\\
which means $\angle ACB = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOB = \boxed{45^\circ}$.

From the text, OA and OB are radii and OA is perpendicular to OB, so the central angle \(\angle AOB\) is \(90^\circ\). Since \(\angle ACB\) is an inscribed angle subtending the same arc \(AB\) as central angle \(\angle AOB\), apply the inscribed angle theorem: \(\angle ACB=\frac12\angle AOB=45^\circ\).

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A and B are lower points on the circle, C is on the opposite arc, and chords \(CA\) and \(CB\) determine \(\angle ACB\). From the text, \(OA\) and \(OB\) are perpendicular radii, so triangle \(AOB\) is a right isosceles triangle with legs equal to the radius \(r\). Therefore \(AB=r\sqrt2\). Since \(AB\) is a chord of the same circle and \(\angle ACB\) is an inscribed angle subtending chord \(AB\), use the chord formula \(AB=2r\sin\angle ACB\). Thus \(r\sqrt2=2r\sin\angle ACB\), so \(\sin\angle ACB=\sqrt2/2\). From the diagram, \(C\) lies on the major arc opposite the minor arc \(AB\), so the relevant inscribed angle is acute; hence \(\angle ACB=45^\circ\).

图像描述：图中是一个圆，圆心标为 O。A、B 是圆下方左右两侧的点，C 在圆的上方圆周上；线段 CA 和 CB 连接到 C，形成 ∠ACB。线段 OA、OB 从圆心 O 分别连到 A、B，表示两条半径，且题目给出 OA ⟂ OB。
推理：设圆的半径为 r。因为 OA 和 OB 都是半径，所以 OA = OB = r；又因为 OA ⟂ OB，所以 ∠AOB = 90°，三角形 AOB 是直角等腰三角形。因此弦 AB 的长度为 AB = r√2。另一方面，AB 是同一个圆中的弦，∠ACB 是圆周角并且对着弦 AB，所以可用弦长公式 AB = 2r sin∠ACB。代入 AB = r√2，得到 r√2 = 2r sin∠ACB，所以 sin∠ACB = √2/2。由图可见 C 在与弦 AB 相对的圆弧上，∠ACB 是锐角，因此 ∠ACB = 45°。
